title: I really wanted this to be the perfect kettle
text:
I really wanted this to be the perfect kettle. I bought this kettle thinking it had everything I wanted - beautiful gooseneck design, quick electric heat-up, pre-set temperature settings, but alas...

Pros:
+ Looks great. Gooseneck design is classic.
+ Pours well. Easy to be precise.
+ Controls are simple to use

Cons:
- THE CRITICAL DESIGN FLAW - the spout! For some reason it extends into the inside of the kettle which means it's hard to get all of the water out because it gets stuck around the part that sticks out into the inside of the kettle. If you make coffee like I do, measuring the water first, then heating, it's important not to have an ounce or two of water sloshing around in there refusing to come out. It's a frustrating exercise tipping the kettle back and forth trying to coax that last bit of water out. WHY!?!
- Makes an annoying clicking noise as it's heating up. I'm guessing this is the heating element going on and shutting off as the PID attempts to hit the target temperature.
